title: RNA Extraction Protocol for Leaves with High Content of Secondary Metabolites
author: Wesley Elias Bhering Barrios
materials: Treat with DNase - gDNA RNA CleanUp Protocol;

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect plant material and freeze immediately in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Tissue Maceration and Lysis
steps.instruction: Macerate and transfer 20 to 30 mg (maximum 50 mg) of tissue to a 1.5 mL microtube.

steps.title: Initial RNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add TRIzol and homogenize the sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL of TRIzol to every 3 tubes at once (or tube by tube if working alone)
Homogenize by vortexing briefly for 5 seconds until the solution turns brown

steps.title: Secondary Metabolite Removal
steps.instruction: Add PVPP to the tubes and incubate to dissociate ribonucleoproteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 mg of PVPP (2 full aliquot spoons) to each tube
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the organic and aqueous phases using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 uL of cold Chloroform (-20ºC)
Vortex vigorously for 15 seconds
Incubate in the thermomixer at 23°C (room T), 700 RPM for 15 min
Centrifuge at 12,000 RPM for 15 min at 4°C
Collect 200 to 300 uL (e.g., 250 uL for safety) of the aqueous phase and transfer to new, labeled 1.5 mL microtubes
Ensure the pipette tips do not touch the middle phase

steps.title: Secondary Chloroform Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second chloroform extraction to further purify the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of chloroform (200 to 300 uL; e.g., 250 uL)
Invert the tubes 20x using a microtube rack or gently vortex for 2 seconds
Incubate in the thermomixer at 23°C (room T), 700 RPM for 10 minutes
Centrifuge at 13,000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4°C
Collect 100 to 200 uL (e.g., 175 uL for safety) of the supernatant and transfer to new, labeled 1.5 mL microtubes

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA using ice-cold isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume of ice-cold isopropanol (e.g., 175 uL) using Molecular Biology Grade - 200 Proof (>99.45%) isopropanol kept at -20°C
Invert the tubes for 30 seconds using a microtube rack or gently vortex for 2 seconds
Incubate for 30 min at -80 °C in a pre-chilled rack, or leave overnight at -20 °C
Centrifuge at 13,000 RPM for 15 minutes at 4°C
Carefully discard the isopropanol using pipette tips

steps.title: RNA Pellet Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with 75% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 uL of 75% ethanol (prepared from Molecular Biology Grade Ethanol - 200 proof) directly to the pellet

Homogenize by lightly tapping the vortex (<1 second) to wash the pellet; ensure tubes are centrifuged with the hinge facing away from the rotor so the pellet is at the bottom in the direction of the hinge
Centrifuge at 13,000 RPM for 10 minutes at 4°C
Carefully dispose of the ethanol with a pipette tip
Repeat the wash and centrifuge steps two more times (total of 3 washes), ensuring excess ethanol is removed without aspirating the pellet

steps.title: RNA Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in treated water.

substeps.instruction: Place open tubes in a laminar flow cabinet (glass closed) at room temperature for 5 minutes, positioned where airflow is strongest
Immediately after removing from the cabin, resuspend in 30 uL of autoclaved Milli-Q Water treated with 0.1% DEPC at 60 °C
Homogenize for 30 seconds per sample using up-and-down pipetting (set pipette to 25 uL to avoid bubbles, or carefully at 30 uL)

steps.title: Quality Control and Storage
steps.instruction: Verify RNA integrity and store samples.

substeps.instruction: Run a 1.5% chlorine-agarose gel (5% commercial bleach added to TAE 1X buffer) using 3 uL sample + 2 uL loading buffer 6X (Gel Red at 9X) at 80 V for 80 min; ensure electrophoresis tank and polymerization tray are cleaned with distilled water and fresh buffer is used
Quantify purity and concentration via Nanodrop or Qubit (Pure RNA: 260/280 > 1.8 and 260/230 > 1.6)
For RNAseq or Microarray, quantify integrity with Bioanalyzer 2100 (RNA 6000 kits) or Tapestation 2200 using the Plant RNA Algorithm
Store samples in the ultra-freezer (-80 ºC) for up to 6 months
